# Go Engineering Skills by Ashwin Gopalsamy

> Evidence-backed Agent Skills for production Go, distributed systems, and fintech. Not affiliated with Google or the Go project.

## Go: Production Engineering

Evidence-backed Go language, API, service, testing, performance, security, operations, and engineering-review skills.

NPM package: @golangskills/engineering

Canonical catalog: catalog/catalog.json

## Go: Distributed Systems

Invariant-driven Go concurrency, consistency, messaging, resilience, coordination, and distributed-change review skills.

NPM package: @golangskills/distributed-systems

Canonical catalog: catalog/catalog.json

## Go: Fintech

Financial-integrity skills for money, ledgers, payment lifecycles, idempotency, settlement, reconciliation, security, and compliance.

NPM package: @golangskills/fintech

Canonical catalog: catalog/catalog.json
